::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 8th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 105-106
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

I am sorry for the mistake, it was not wilful for I looked at the stamp, and found it so pale that I saw nothing but the Cl which I took for [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd).[^1]

Will ‘By-words in  action’ do for the name of [this collection of stories](cmy_books/cmybook_135.qmd), as all illustrate some saying or other. I have recovered one from America, and will send it in a day or two, but I think it will be safer to send these last three together  

Perhaps I may add two semi-translations from the French

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The mistake was evidently in sending some material to the wrong printer.
